title: How Good Are GPT Models at Machine Translation? A Comprehensive Evaluation

bias_targets.methodology: Quantifying translation artifacts by measuring translation non-monotonicity, translation fluency (using perplexity scores), punctuation insertion, and the number of unaligned source and target words to determine if the model favors target language fluency over faithful adequacy.

Splitting test sets into buckets based on the perplexity of the source sentence (low-quality vs. high-quality inputs) and comparing the performance of GPT models against standard NMT models to see if they resonate with noisy parts of web-mined parallel corpora.

Comparing translation quality and model performance across 18 different language pairs to measure the performance disparity between high-resource (English-centric) languages and low-resource or non-English-centric underrepresented languages.
